text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What I want for a birthday present, huh? 
...Actually, you know, I've wanted it for 
a long time.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Won't you write lyrics for the melodia I 
compose, Royce-san!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So light!? Wait, were you always good at 
that kind of thing?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, my experience writing an original 
song for self-promotion is about to pay 
off big time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's some serious confidence...! 
I'm glad it came true for you, Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahh...! This isn't a dream, is it? To 
think you would dye my sound in your 
colors...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
My idol, the amore who lights my path. 
With your solitary individuality and 
original ideas, please bring an energico 
rhythm to my musica.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Come, Royce-san. Let us begin our special 
armonia!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If we're doing this, let's make it a smash 
hit block-buster! With Earth-san's 
gorgeous melody, my ultimate lyrics, and 
Nature-san's beautiful voice!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Did I say I was gonna sing!?
